values.en: Comparison of vanishing quantities, stated as relations between domain-carrying functions at a point rather than as informal orders of magnitude. This is the vocabulary Taylor's theorem with Peano remainder is phrased in.
values.zh-CN: 对趋于零的量进行比较，并将其表述为自带定义域的函数在一点处的关系，而非非形式化的数量级。这正是带佩亚诺余项的泰勒定理所采用的语言。
